b2-08-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Rest Should Have Been Ordered
b2-08-01.scenario: The old doctor has just left the sickroom, and Kárász Nelli (you) says what should have happened weeks ago: her husband should have rested.
b2-08-01.prompt: Tell the doctor what her husband should have done weeks ago.
cues: Say who should have done it
Say what he should have done and how long ago
b2-08-01.target: A férjemnek már hetekkel ezelőtt pihennie kellett volna.
b2-08-01.english: My husband should have rested weeks ago already.
b2-08-01.canDo: I can express unfulfilled past obligations using kellett volna + infinitive.

b2-08-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Could Have Been Prevented
b2-08-02.scenario: On the porch the old doctor says the worsening could have been prevented. You (Nelli) agree and say it could have been prevented if your husband had listened to the doctor.
b2-08-02.prompt: Tell the doctor what could have been prevented and under what condition.
cues: Say what could have been prevented
Say what your husband should have done
b2-08-02.target: Megelőzhettük volna a súlyosbodást, ha a férjem hallgatott volna az orvosra.
b2-08-02.english: We could have prevented the worsening if my husband had listened to the doctor.
b2-08-02.canDo: I can form the potential past conditional (-hatott/-hetett volna) in both conjugations.

b2-08-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Past and Present Duty
b2-08-03.scenario: By the sickbed Nelli (you) tells the doctor that she should have done more earlier, but now she must nurse her husband.
b2-08-03.prompt: Contrast what you should have done earlier with what you must do now.
cues: Say what you should have done earlier
Say what you must do now
b2-08-03.target: Korábban többet kellett volna tennem, most viszont ápolnom kell a férjemet.
b2-08-03.english: Earlier I should have done more, but now I must nurse my husband.
b2-08-03.canDo: I can contrast ongoing moral duty (kellene / volna szabad) with past hindsight (kellett volna).

b2-08-04.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Could Have Known
b2-08-04.scenario: In the dim sickroom Nelli (you) says to the old doctor that she could have known her husband was ill but did not pay attention to him.
b2-08-04.prompt: Tell the doctor what you could have known.
cues: Say what you could have known
Say what you did not do
b2-08-04.target: Tudhattam volna, hogy a férjem beteg, de nem figyeltem rá.
b2-08-04.english: I could have known that my husband was ill, but I did not pay attention to him.
b2-08-04.canDo: I can express what someone could or should have foreseen using tudhatta volna and sejthette volna.

b2-08-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Do Not Blame Yourself
b2-08-05.scenario: On the porch you are the old doctor and you comfort Nelli: she watched at her husband's side day and night, and nobody could have done more.
b2-08-05.prompt: Comfort Nelli and tell her why she need not blame herself.
cues: Tell her not to blame herself
Say what she did and that nobody could have done more
b2-08-05.target: Ne vádolja magát, asszonyom! Éjjel-nappal virrasztott, ennél többet senki sem tehetett volna.
b2-08-05.english: Do not blame yourself, madam! You kept vigil day and night; nobody could have done more than this.
b2-08-05.canDo: I can synthesize deontic, potential, and epistemic past modals in a bioethical argument.

b2-08-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Weeks Before
b2-08-consolidation.scenario: Nelli (you) tells the old doctor what should not have been allowed weeks ago: her husband should not have been out in the cold for hours.
b2-08-consolidation.prompt: Tell the doctor what should not have been allowed.
cues: Say what should not have been allowed
Say who it concerned and for how long
b2-08-consolidation.target: Nem szabadott volna megengednem, hogy a férjem órákig a hidegben legyen.
b2-08-consolidation.english: I should not have allowed my husband to be out in the cold for hours.
b2-08-consolidation.canDo: I can express unfulfilled obligations and violated prohibitions with kellett volna and nem szabadott volna.
